items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Saxophone player was Harold "Dee" Leon Washington. The drummer was West.

ctx.x: So Roy was working at the Three Deuces at that time in Chicago. But the more I listened to him, I'd say, "That dude sure sound like Roy Eldridge, but he's at the Deuces." So intermission comes, they all gathered over there and they were doing their thing, I sat over there by Lil Armstrong, and they called me over and they introduced themselves. So Roy says, "I'm Little Jazz."
Now, I don't know anything about Little Jazz. All I know is Roy Eldridge, you know. Saxophone player was Harold "Dee" Leon Washington. The drummer was West. So my E string

broke. Left me playing with three strings. And this excited Roy. Oh, he just started dancing all over the bandstand. Say, "Man, come on and go down ever to my job with me." I say, "Your job?" He say, "Yeah, down at the Three Deuces." And then I almost fainted.
